text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
An AI-powered fitness machine—
Devising efficient training based on collected data... Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Mmh, is it that late already?
Once I finish this page, I must go to sleep—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
! The AI measures muscle mass
and sets the load right up to the limit.
There are sample training videos too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Duramente ended up staying up late, too intrigued by the state-of-the-art training equipment...
